name: ask-your-audience
description: Ask Human Digital Twins, built from real people, what they think of your ideas, messages and ads. You see the brief and the cost first, and nothing runs until you approve.

interface.longDescription: Before you make the decision, Ask Your Audience. Help product, marketing and research teams explore concepts, messaging and supplied creative with audience-matched digital twins. Connect your existing AYA account, select an existing audience, and prepare a Concept Test, Image Ad Evaluator, Focus Group or Interview when available for your account and connection. Review the exact brief, participants and study cost before explicitly approving a run. Discuss returned findings and evidence in chat, or open an AYA visual when useful. Digital twin responses are simulated qualitative research, not a representative survey or a prediction of real-world outcomes. Saved study access depends on separately approved permissions.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a Concept Test for this proposition with an audience in my AYA account.
Help me understand the findings from my completed AYA study.
